note: Hamilton County Conservation Board park on the Boone River about 6 miles NE of Stratford, reached by gravel road. Grass sites with no marked pads, set around an open lawn inside a river bend, with an open-air shelter, playground, canoe ramp and the old Bell's Mill site. Dumpsters only May 15 - October 15 (carry in, carry out otherwise); the dump station, hydrants and shower house may be shut to prevent freezing while the campground stays open. --Claude
summary: Changed: booking reservable/operator -> first come, first served (cashless QR pay at site), 14-night max; season set Apr 1 - Oct 31; facilities and 30-amp confirmed; $20 + $4 fee confirmed. Waterfront upgrade lead (riverview -> riverfront).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, riverview -> riverfront): the county's campground map (2017, on spring-2016 imagery) puts sites A, B, C, D and 19-24 on the open lawn between the campground road and the Boone River, with no road between them and the bank. On NAIP (180 m frame at 42.34002,-93.89098) the grass is mown to the bank top with only scattered trees, and the picnic tables of the river-side sites sit about 20-25 m from the water. The Boone here is about 45-55 m bank to bank including a large gravel bar (the wetted channel at low water beside the camp is about 12-16 m), so it reads as a river, not a creek. The stored evidence ('~40-70m back across wooded riparian bank') and the note's 'continuous treeline screens the sites from the riverbank' don't match the map or the imagery; I removed the treeline sentence from the note. The bank is a short eroded slope down to the water, not a beach.

BOOKING: the stored 'reservable via mycountyparks.com' is wrong. Every listed Bell's Mill site (01-24 on MyCountyParks) says 'This site is available on a first-come, first-served basis only' and pay at site by QR code; the county page says all three county campgrounds are cashless first-come. Only Briggs Woods and Little Wall Lake have 'Reserve' sites, for holidays.

SITE COUNT: the park page says 45 electric + 4 primitive (49, kept). The 2017 county map numbers only sites 1-34 plus A-D, and MyCountyParks lists 24 electric pay-at-site facilities. The 49 is the county's current text.
PRIMITIVE RATE: the park page says $15 and the camping page $12. The base stays the $20 electric site, since it isn't stated whether a motorhome may use the primitive sites.

PHONE (missing): the entry has none. Bell's Mill Park and Little Wall Lake ranger: 515-297-0359; Hamilton County Conservation office: (515) 832-9570 (both on https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Hamilton.aspx). apply.py doesn't write phone.
PIN OK: 42.3407,-93.8899 is on Bells Mill Road about 95 m NE of the middle of the camping lawn (about 42.3401,-93.8907). Under the 250 m line. Fit: grass sites, no length posted, no limit stated.
